description: This is the main FastAPI backend source file for the NotesApp project. It defines the API routes, data models, middleware setup, and application creation for the backend server, including health checks and CRUD operations for notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note, including id, title, and content.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a new note, including title and optional content.

methods.name: create_app
methods.description: Creates and configures the FastAPI application with routes, middleware, and data models.

methods.name: healthz
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify backend health.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns the list of all stored notes.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
